connector.name: Proton Mail (unofficial)
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial Proton Mail MCP - send, read, search & organize email over SMTP and IMAP
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package proton-mail-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sethbang account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROTONMAIL_PASSWORD
env.description: Your Proton Mail SMTP password (not your login password; generate one in Proton settings)

env.name: PROTONMAIL_SECURE
env.description: Use TLS for SMTP (true for port 465)

env.name: IMAP_HOST
env.description: Proton Mail Bridge IMAP host (required for read/search tools)

env.name: IMAP_USERNAME
env.description: Proton Mail Bridge username (falls back to PROTONMAIL_USERNAME)

env.name: IMAP_PASSWORD
env.description: Proton Mail Bridge password (falls back to PROTONMAIL_PASSWORD)

env.name: READONLY
env.description: Disable all mutating tools (send, move, delete, flags, labels, bulk ops, folder/label management)

env.name: RESTRICT_OUTBOUND_TO_SELF
env.description: Refuse live sends to any recipient other than PROTONMAIL_USERNAME (for throwaway/QA accounts)

env.name: ALLOW_FILE_DOWNLOAD_DIR
env.description: Allowlist directory enabling download_attachment.saveTo; when unset, attachments return as inline base64
